text: Only me left. Then I will tell them in the forest what you did here.
I am still breathing. Dziękuję. Thank you.
Just me, then. I'll see the night out with you.
Still standing. Someone has to tell them at home.
Only me. I will stay with you until it is over.
Still alive. Danke. I did not think I would say that tonight.
Last one standing. Guess the paperwork's on me.
Still here. I'll put you all in my report. The good parts.
Just me left. Guess I'm with you now.
Still kicking. Thanks for having our backs.
I am the last one. I will report what we saw here.
Still alive. Spasibo, comrades.
I am the last of us. Forty years in that village... Danke. Thank you.
Still here. I will tell their wives they stood.
We go now. Others wait for us in the forest. Z Bogiem.
We cannot stay. Good luck to you. Hold your ground.
Right, the boats won't wait. We're off. Good luck.
That's us. Back to the beach, lads, at the double.
We take a boat, if there is one left. Viel Glück.
We go along the shore. Maybe the British will take us.
Orders are to secure the gate. We're moving out.
We're pulling back to the radar tower. Good luck.
We gotta find our outfit. Good luck, folks.
That's our cue. Rally point's west. Keep your heads down.
Our orders are east. We go. Udachi, comrades.
We must report this. Hold out. We go back.
We go to our families now. Gott schütze euch.
Enough. We are going home, if there is still a home.
Armia Krajowa! Don't shoot, we are with you. We heard the guns from the forest.
Spokojnie, friends. Home Army. We came the long way round the dead.
We are Home Army, from the woods. Tell us where you want us.
Commando. Came in off the beach. Thought you could use a hand.
Don't shoot, we're British! Came in with the boats.
Evening. We heard the racket from the water. Where do you want us?
Nicht schießen! Navy. We left the pens. We are done with all of it.
We are sailors, not fighters. But we can shoot. Let us help.
The port is lost. Mein Gott, the things in the water. We come to you.
Military Police! Range security. Who's in charge here?
MPs, from the motor pool. The whole range has gone to hell.
Stand easy, we're with you. Nobody told us about any of this.
Hey! Don't shoot, we're Americans! Jumped last night and missed by about forty miles.
Airborne. We got scattered all over this valley. Mind if we tag along?
Thank God, somebody alive. We've been fighting these things since we hit the ground.
Razvedka! Red Army scouts. We followed your shooting.
Tovarishchi! Easy with the rifles. We are scouts, from the east.
Soviet patrol. We saw the dead walking on the road and came to see who is still alive.
Nicht schießen! We are only old men from the village. We threw the armbands in the ditch.
Volkssturm, ja. But we are finished with that. Let us stand with you.
We heard you fighting. Better to stand here than hang for running.
Ah! It's nothing. Nothing.
Psiakrew... they bit through the coat.
Ah, the blighter got me.
I'm hit. Carry on, carry on.
Verdammt, I am hit.
Ah... it is nothing. Keep shooting.
Ah! I'm hit!
Took one. Still in it.
I'm hit! I'm okay, I'm okay.
Son of a gun got me.
Chyort! I am hit.
Only a scratch. Keep shooting.
Ach... my old bones.
I am hit. It is not so bad. Not so bad.
There, by the trees! Ognia!
They come! Hold the line, chłopaki!
Dead ones, many. Shoot for the head!
Man down! Pomocy, help him!
They have Stefan! Get him up!
Contact front! Bloody hundreds of them!
Here they come, lads. Make every round count.
Rapid fire! Heads, aim for the heads!
Man down! Get to him!
Taff's down! Somebody pull him back!
Achtung! On the quay, there!
Feuer frei! Fire, fire!
They come out of the water. Shoot!
Hein is down! Help him!
They have Jupp! Pull him back!
Here they come! Weapons free!
Contact on the salt! Open fire!
Those were our guys this morning. Shoot 'em anyway!
Sarge is down! Get him up!
Man down! Cover me, I'm going for him!
Here they come! Light 'em up!
Contact! Shoot for the head, they don't stop otherwise!
Holy smokes, there's a ton of 'em!
Medic! Somebody get Murphy back up!
Man down! Cover him!
Here they come! Vperyod!
Ogon! Fire, fire!
Davai, davai, shoot them in the head!
Sasha is down! Pomogi!
They got Kolya! Somebody, get him!
Da! There they come. Steady, old hands.
Feuer! Aim low, Herr Nachbar, they are close.
Mein Gott, so many. Shoot, shoot!
Karl is down! Help him up, quickly!
They have the schoolmaster! Get him!
